title: NASA features image of Perseid meteor over Canary Islands observatory
excerpt: A photograph captures a meteor trail near the Large-Sized Telescope at the Observatorio del Roque de los Muchachos.
bodyHtml:
NASA published an image on September 26, 2026, showing a Perseid meteor streaking through the sky over the Observatorio del Roque de los Muchachos in La Palma, Canary Islands. The photograph, taken on August 15, depicts the meteor trail alongside the Milky Way.

The foreground of the image features the 23 meter diameter mirror of the prototype Large-Sized Telescope, or LST-1. According to NASA, individual mirror segments of the telescope reflected the atmospheric flash of the meteor during the event.

LST-1 is the first telescope constructed at the northern hemisphere site of the Cherenkov Telescope Array Observatory. The telescope is designed to detect atmospheric visible light flashes, which last about a billionth of a second and are triggered by energetic gamma-rays from cosmic sources such as distant active galaxies and gamma-ray bursts.
